in_marathi.name: Bhagaban
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagaban हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhagaban is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'bhag' meaning fortune, god, or prosperity, and 'bana' meaning protector, or one who gives. Thus, Bhagaban translates to 'Lord, God, or Protector of Fortune'. This name is often used for deities and divine beings in Hindu mythology, particularly in the Vaishnavism tradition.
